basic_info.description: Welcome to this fabulous fully renovated Noe Valley home with nothing was spared, has it all; 2 bdrms + 1 Den/Office, 3.5 baths, a fantastic floorplan, great lighting + custom made cabinets, professional grade Thermador appliances and access to the roof deck with panoramic view of SF Downtown and Bay Bridge, 1 spacious bed -(master suite offer huge bath with custom made vanity, stand free tub + shower, large closet and Europe imported tiles) rear deck with direct access to gorgeous, large rear yard + hall bath and views of SF Downtown living room and dining area completes the main level with showcases an open plan kitchen/living room/large dining area with sleek lighting, glass paned stairways leads to the roof deck and lower level with tremendous size family/party room offers with custom made cabinets, wet bar, another full bath, and a den/office, 2nd master suite custom made closet with full bath and direct access to the amazing, low maintenance rear yard with covered oversized decking,. Too Much To List, do not miss this must see house.
